title: Cross-Protocol Personality Assessment with LLMs: Aligning Behavioral Evidence with Human Ratings
abstract: arXiv:2610.16050v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personality assessment from asynchronous video interviews (AVIs) plays a crucial role in recruitment by enabling standardized and behaviorally grounded evaluation for job applicants. However, most of the previous works are confined to a single interview protocol. Independently collected protocols differ in question sets and question-trait mapping. Thus, the human-rated evidence from one protocol cannot be used directly under another. To address this limitation, we propose the Cross-protocol Evidence-grounded Personality Assessment (CEPA) framework, which aligns behavioral representations across interview protocols. CEPA addresses protocol heterogeneity by projecting source behavioral records into the target protocol's construct-oriented representation space. It retrieves behaviorally relevant and personality-complementary human-rated exemplars to ground an ensemble of LLM raters, which enables behavior-to-personality associations without

translated_title: 基于大语言模型的跨协议人格评估：将行为证据与人类评分对齐
translated_abstract: 异步视频面试（AVI）的人格评估在招聘中发挥着至关重要的作用，它能够为求职者提供标准化且基于行为的评估。然而，以往的大多数工作仅局限于单一的面试协议。独立收集的协议在问题集合和问题-特质映射上存在差异，因此来自某一协议的人工评分证据无法直接用于另一协议。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了跨协议证据驱动的人格评估（CEPA）框架，该框架能够对齐不同面试协议之间的行为表征。CEPA通过将源协议的行为记录投影到目标协议面向构念的表征空间中，来解决协议异质性问题。它检索行为相关且人格互补的人工评分示例，为大语言模型评分器集合提供依据，从而在无需……的情况下实现行为与人格之间的关联。
tldr: 提出CEPA框架，通过将不同面试协议的行为表征对齐到目标协议的表征空间，并检索人工评分示例来驱动大语言模型评分器，实现了跨面试协议的视频人格评估。
en_tdlr: The CEPA framework aligns behavioral representations across interview protocols and grounds an ensemble of LLM raters with human-rated exemplars, enabling cross-protocol personality assessment from asynchronous video interviews.
